host_and_run_metadata: Each run's metadata.json and metrics.jsonl retain UTC times, elapsed duration, host load, image/controller objects, and input hashes.
limitations: Host contention was observed but not controlled
Control-plane static pods displayed 0/1 readiness although the node, API, scheduler, metrics, workload, and operator were functional
Docker socket access was sandbox-blocked; the already-running cluster was verified directly through its Kubernetes API
Free filesystem space was limited but remained above the 1 GiB orchestration guard
